reviews.review: Easily my favorite game. There's just so much you can do

ArmA 3, a massive military sandbox with elements of simulation, tactics and strategy.

A bit more futuristic than the previous ArmA games, a bit more sunny and vibrant.

A bit more streamlined, more accessible, but still pretty "hardcore".

Just as hardware demanding, perhaps too much in some ways.

Just as moddable, with a dedicated community that makes things happen.

Full of DLC, something that doesn't appeal to me too much.

Full of role playing servers, a strange but interesting phenomenon.

As my hour count says, I'm barely touching the surface of this massive game, as it's a massive time sink for those willing to inverst time and dedication into it.

It's basically more games in one game, with a ton of different possible play styles, modes, mods and so on.

This alone gives it a great value for your money, but know that if you aren't willing to dedicate to it or don't have good enough hardware (forget about it on some cheap laptops or some such), you might be better off with something more accessible and less demanding.

PC's premier military game indeed.

Overall one of the best games i have ever played this was one of the first games I have ever played on steam besides arma 2 and I hope to follow the series and what is to come amazing game deserverse more popularity than it already has. Devs are great and are always giving back to the community.

I would probably say that this is a good game for realism, simulation, and cooperation. I'm gonna start with the cons. Theres somewhat of a gap between players who bought dlc and player's who didn't, the ladder are denied a suprising chunk of servers and gameplay content. And I wouldn't say the editor and singleplayer aren't good but they are less featured than the multiplayer, and if your planning on getting this game you should probably have a microphone because mics are a HUGE part of communication. Ok thats not all the cons but if i had to list all of them it would take all day, so here are the pros. The game itself has a huge variety of vehicles, weapons, and landscapes (Some Locked Behind Pay Wall) and the realistic combat allows players to feel immersed in this military setting. Even though the combat isnt as exciting as say COD but its incredibly realistic, although I can't say the same for the graphics which aren't bad but there just under par of the recent games. Overall i'd say it's a good game to buy if your into tactical realism and more cooperative based combat.
